# Protocol fixture provenance

`protocol.json` is self-contained. Its synthetic CRC, framing, identity and field-scaling expectations were generated by the original Python implementation independently of the app. No Python prototype is required to run the tests. The browser decoder and native Swift decoder consume the retained vectors.

Two telemetry entries are sanitized live observations: a stationary packet and an unloaded-pedal packet containing 14.1823 rpm and 1 W controller-reported rider power. They establish byte decoding, not physical calibration. The remaining entries are synthetic.

No device identifier, raw serial, source timestamp, location or full ride is included. Identity labels are synthetic. CSV tests use synthetic timestamps and clearly identified field modifications.

The command-4 framing vector tests CRC/reassembly only. The app can construct only identity 111 and fixed selective telemetry 50 requests.
